name: e04_cuarentena
sql: select 'customers' entidad, rejection_reason, _batch_id, count(*) from quarantine.quarantine_mysql__customers group by 1,2,3 union all select 'products', rejection_reason, _batch_id, count(*) from quarantine.quarantine_mysql__products group by 1,2,3 union all select 'orders', rejection_reason, _batch_id, count(*) from quarantine.quarantine_mysql__orders group by 1,2,3 union all select 'order_items', rejection_reason, _batch_id, count(*) from quarantine.quarantine_mysql__order_items group by 1,2,3 union all select 'reviews', rejection_reason, _batch_id, count(*) from quarantine.quarantine_mongodb__reviews group by 1,2,3 union all select 'navigation_events', rejection_reason, _batch_id, count(*) from quarantine.quarantine_mongodb__navigation_events group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2
